comments.author: fritzo
comments.body:
Hi @fonnesbeck it looks like this is a bug in the model. To fix locally I believe you can fix the indexing, something like this:
```diff
  def model(data, params):
      # initialize data
      J = data["J"]
      N = data["N"]
      county = data["county"].long() - 1
      y = data["y"]
      sigma_eta =  pyro.sample("sigma_eta", dist.Uniform(0., 100.))
      sigma_y =  pyro.sample("sigma_y", dist.Uniform(0., 100.))
      mu =  pyro.sample("mu", dist.Normal(0., 1.))
      with pyro.plate("J", J):
          eta =  pyro.sample("eta", dist.Normal(0., sigma_eta))
      with pyro.plate("data", N):
-         y_hat = 0.1 * mu + eta[county]
+         y_hat = 0.1 * mu + eta[..., county]  # or something like this
          y =  pyro.sample("y", dist.Normal(y_hat, sigma_y), obs=y)
```
The issues is that during quantiles (or any other multiple-sample method), `eta` is batched, and the naive `eta[county]` indexes into the wrong dimension.
